scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-worker --env development
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:frontend && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:frontend && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DDNS_DB --local --env development
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DDNS_DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DDNS_DB --remote --env production
